angleRead.name: Elliot Graye
angleRead.text: I'm looking at a week where the big cathedrals are filling up for Epiphany, but the smaller spaces are doing the heavy lifting on crisis response. I want to spend some time at Lakeshore Unitarian—I've seen the volunteers stacking chairs at the church lately and it feels like the right place to start. I'm chasing the contrast between the ritual of the holiday and the quiet, unglamorous work of keeping doors open for people in Chinatown and Downtown. I want to see who stays late to clean up after the community support sessions.
